versions.changelog:
**Major hardening release with new residual-risk controls for sensitive session data:**

- Adds a Gate 4 platform consent ledger (~/.bws/consents.json); one-time per-site consent now required for sensitive calls (via --accept-platform-consent).
- Emits a machine-readable transparency block to stderr on every sensitive call (or all calls with BWS_TRANSPARENCY=1), detailing third-party package and audit info.
- New --dry-run flag to exercise all access gates and audit logging without loading untrusted code—ideal for CI workflows.
- Underlying npm dependency remains pinned and integrity-verified (0.4.3, unchanged).
- SECURITY.md added.

**Sensitive tier is now sealed by default for enhanced security.**

- Sensitive adapters now require both BWS_ENABLE_SENSITIVE_TIER=1 and per-call/session opt-in (BWS_ALLOW_SENSITIVE=1 or equivalent).
- Addresses ClawScan May 2026 security recommendations on privilege abuse and tool misuse.
- Underlying npm package remains pinned at version 0.4.3; no change to supply chain integrity gate.
- Updated documentation and environment variable gating order for clarity and defense-in-depth.

Initial release of browser-web-search for OpenClaw:

- Transform any website into a command-line API using browser login status.
- Supports 13 platforms and 41 commands (e.g., Zhihu, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, GitHub, Douban).
- No Chrome extension or daemon needed; deeply integrated with OpenClaw browser.
- All outputs are structured JSON with optional jq filtering.
- Ensures local execution, privacy, and reuses existing login sessions.
- Includes built-in platform/adapter listing, command search, and error handling.
